title: Serve uploaded attachments through the API
description: Adds a helper that reads a user's uploaded attachment from disk and a small checksum utility the download response advertises in its Content-Digest header.

expected.note: `fileName` comes from the request and is joined straight onto `UPLOADS_DIR`, so `../../etc/passwd` (or an absolute path) escapes the uploads directory and lets a caller read arbitrary files. Resolve the path and verify it stays within `UPLOADS_DIR`, or reject names containing `..`, `/` or `\`.
The function declares a `string` return type but computes `digest` and never returns it, so callers receive `undefined`. Add `return digest;`.
